newsitem.title: INDIA: Bombay sugar prices unchanged on limited supply.
newsitem.headline: Bombay sugar prices unchanged on limited supply.

text.p: Bombay sugar prices on Tuesday held steady in a narrow range on the local market, dealers said.
Consumer demand and retail interest were slow amid the tail-end of the month but limited supplies kept prices around last levels.
In ready delivery sugar S-30 was quiet at 1,470/1,498 rupees per quintal and sugar M-30 at 1,495/1,526 rupees per quintal.
"Inflows were low from mills to the market as local millers have sold out almost all quantities of sugar allotted to them out of the free sale quota of July," one broker said.
Sugar mill delivery remained unquoted due to negligible offerings by millers.
The free sale quota for July is 750,000 tonnes against 800,000 tonnes released in June. The quota for August is 750,000 tonnes.
"Sugar prices may turn firm in the firm week of August on festival buying," one dealer said.
